name: Prism 02 - Intent Router
description: Classifies user messages into a Prism intent (CHAT, CONNECTOR_<id>, BRIEFING, SEARCH, PLAN_CREATE/MODIFY/APPROVE) using Gemini Flash. Webhook: POST /webhook/prism-intent. Degrades gracefully to CHAT on parse failure; returns the standard Prism envelope.

parameters.text:
=You are the Prism intent classifier. Prism connects Microsoft (Outlook mail, Outlook Calendar, OneDrive, SharePoint, Dynamics 365 CRM) and Zoho (CRM, Projects, Books) plus an organization knowledge base.

User message:
"{{ $json.body?.message || $json.message || "" }}"

Enabled context: {{ JSON.stringify($json.body?.connectorContext || $json.connectorContext || {}) }}

Classify the intent as exactly one of:
- "CHAT" - general question, planning help, knowledge query, or conversation not asking to fetch live connector data.
- "CONNECTOR_<id>" - an explicit request to query a live data source, where <id> is one of: microsoft.outlook, microsoft.sharepoint, microsoft.dynamics, zoho.crm, zoho.projects, zoho.books, internal.kb. Example: "show my unread mail" -> CONNECTOR_microsoft.outlook.
- "BRIEFING" - user asks for a daily/executive briefing combining several sources.
- "SEARCH" - user asks to search across multiple sources.
- "PLAN_CREATE" - user gives concrete details to build a campaign/initiative plan naming a real client.
- "PLAN_MODIFY" - user asks to change an existing plan.
- "PLAN_APPROVE" - user confirms approval / push to execute a plan.

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences:
{
  "intent": "CHAT",
  "reasoning": "one sentence",
  "connectorId": "microsoft.outlook or null",
  "topics": ["array of key topics"],
  "requestedAction": "summarize, list, draft, create, update, or null"
}

parameters.content:
## Prism 02 - Intent Router (POST /webhook/prism-intent)
Classifies user messages with Gemini into CHAT / CONNECTOR_<id> / BRIEFING / SEARCH / PLAN_*. Degrades gracefully to CHAT on any parse failure so the chat never hard-fails. Returns the standard Prism envelope.
